opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases; most grants below £300,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not funded: individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, unaffiliated individuals, schools or further education colleges, undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, establishment of academic posts, local charities, etc. Overseas organisations only in exceptional cases with strong UK dissemination plans.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions from its Strategic Review, aiming to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK-based researchers and organisations; applicants from diverse backgrounds and racially minoritised communities encouraged; partnership applications between researchers and communities strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society, focusing on racial diversity within the UK. 2026 priority theme: Inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year (Autumn).
